# Vendored Plotly runtime

`plotly.min.js` is generated verbatim by `plotly.offline.get_plotlyjs()` from
the pinned `plotly==6.9.0` Python package. That package bundles Plotly.js
v3.7.0 under the MIT license; its copyright and license notice remain in the
first lines of the generated file.
